note: The session's shared web-search allowance was used up (200 of 200) when this part began, so no candidate could be searched for; only government pages at known or linked addresses were read. Many county and school sites did not resolve or reset the connection (Kenton County's old domain, Bullitt, Carter, Mercer, Henry, Crittenden, Anderson and Woodford counties, Mercer County Sheriff, Greenup County Schools). Boyd County Schools' board page does not list Aaron S. Profit (not an incumbent there); Nelson County Schools' board page names nobody; Hopkinsville's council page does not name Desaepa Vansauwa. The Hardin County Republican Party links Walt Meinhausen to a Facebook page only (a social profile, not a website; its listing is already in ballot/lean/ky_endorsements.json, as is the Republican Party of Kentucky's listing of Mitch Whitaker and the Madison County Democrats' listing of Robert Blythe, none saying endorsed). The other 27 candidates were left blank. Verifier (2026-10-03): all three candidates' pages re-opened; each names the person in the office our record shows for the 2026 race (Kentucky plus the same county or city office); every finding confirmed.
